SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(site_avgs.avg_ram) AS avg_of_site_avg_ram, AVG(site_avgs.avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_of_site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT p.zoneref, si.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio
  FROM scanprocessing AS p
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = p.zoneref
  WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8
  GROUP BY p.zoneref, si.entrystat
) AS site_avgs
GROUP BY s.entrystat
